why: The revision the NEXT re-vendor moves to, which is not the revision we are
vendoring now: `commit` above says what spec/predicates/... currently IS and the
drift gate holds the bytes to it. scripts/vendor-remap-test.py compares the
current vendored text against THIS revision, to prove the remap carries every
anchor onto the same prose before the move rather than after it.
It is pinned because that check used to read a sibling clone's WORKING TREE. On
2026-09-20 a lane cut that clone's copy from 2322 lines to 278 and amended it
three times in two hours; three branches that touch neither the vendored page nor
any citation went red at different times for a reason none of them contained.
